name: Package launcher (pacseek-style)
description: Launcher-style package overlay: live search across the sync repos (pacman) and the AUR (via a configurable helper: paru or yay, chosen in Settings), installed badges, and install/remove handed off to an interactive terminal where the helper owns the sudo prompt and progress. Keyboard-first: type, arrows, Enter installs, Ctrl+D removes. Opened via the pkg-launcher command (SUPER+SHIFT+P) or the IPC service.
author: And0Null
permissions: Registers a Visibilities module and IPC command (pkg-launcher)
Runs read-only package searches: pacman -Ss and the configured AUR helper's -Ss (requires the paru or yay binary)
